Strategic Fix: Enforce a mandatory closing script that secures either an immediate appointment ora confirmed callback time window plus an automated SMS/email confirmation to lock intent intoa scheduled action. - Issue 2: Repeated mis-capture and failure to summarize critical contact and case details (names, emails, county , issue type) produce follow-up failures and lost leads. Strategic Fix: Require verbal read-back of key fields with immediate CRM entry and validation prompts, routing ambiguous entries toa supervisor for same-day clarification. - Issue 3: Low demonstrated empathy and absence of concise service/fee information undermine trust for sensitive family-law callers and reduce urgency to engage. Strategic Fix: Implement brief empathy and value-statement prompts in the intake script plus standard one-line fee/range templates, reinforced by targeted training and QA scoring.
